articles.title: Wildfire now nine miles from French city of Bordeaux, mayor warns
articles.description: Thomas Cazenave says they are preparing if further evacuations are issued, as the mayor of a nearby town called the situation "catastrophic".

articles.title: Devastating European wildfires in maps - and how they're being tackled
articles.description: A blaze near Bordeaux has torn through more than 162 sq miles (420 sq km) in less than four days, while the Madrid region is seeing its worst fires ever.

articles.title: Reform UK reports Zack Polanski to police over guillotine T-shirt post
articles.description: The post included a photo of a man wearing a top featuring the name "Nigel" alongside an image of a guillotine.

articles.title: New technical education routes to be offered at 14 in England
articles.description: The government wants pupils to take subjects like AI and manufacturing which are linked to local jobs.
